description: Busyness for a venue at a specific hour or day — reads an already-forecasted venue (by venue_id from besttime_forecast). Pass `hour` for a single hour, or omit it to get the whole day's curve. Example: besttime_query({ venue_id: "ven_...", day: 4, hour: 18, _apiKey: "pri_xxx:pub_yyy" })

day.description: Day of week 0-6 (0=Monday … 6=Sunday). Defaults to 0 (Monday) if omitted.

hour.description: Hour of day 0-23 (optional). If given, returns that hour's busyness intensity.

name: besttime_query
